read.thesis: Q1 organic sales +8% with aftermarket +21% and backlog $217B (+8%); $850M net tariff hit excluded from guidance, Raytheon book-to-bill 0.7 in quarter but 1.35 rolling 12-month.

capex.quote: this year, we're planning another $2 billion of investment to further increase our US capacity.

triggers.label: Aftermarket sales +21% organic
triggers.quote: Commercial aftermarket sales were up 21%, commercial OE sales were up 3%

triggers.label: PW1100 MRO output +35% YoY
triggers.quote: PW1100 MRO output was up 35% year-over-year and 14% sequentially

triggers.label: Tariff $850M excluded from outlook
triggers.quote: we have not included the potential tariff impacts in our outlook for the year at this time
triggers.highlight: not included the potential tariff impacts

triggers.label: Raytheon margin 10.7%, 12%+ target
triggers.quote: We think it can get back into the 12%-plus range and will.

guidance.quote: operating profit growth between $500 million and $600 million versus 2024
operating profit growth between $325 million and $400 million versus 2024
operating profit growth between $150 million and $225 million versus 2024
We expect a book-to-bill of 1.0 or more.

red_flags.label: Tariff exposure $850M net, excluded from outlook
red_flags.quote: we have not included the potential tariff impacts in our outlook for the year at this time

red_flags.label: Raytheon sales down 5% adjusted, book-to-bill 0.7 in quarter
red_flags.quote: Bookings in the quarter were $4.4 billion, resulting in a book-to-bill of 0.7

evasions.quote: I don't think it's not a panacea for all things tariff.
